'''Kai Lunn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iol]] at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history. Lunn acted as the leader of the [[Miners' Union]], a [[Union (workers)|trade union]] that sought to uphold the rights of workers on Iol. The majority of the residents of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Shirkel]] pledged their allegiance to Lunn.<ref name="TUR" />
